transfer.name: Bilt Rewards
transfer.quote: Points transfer at a 1:1 ratio for Bilt travel partners.

fee.quote: Annual Fee $0; each authorized user: $0 per year.

earning.quote: 3X on hotels through Bilt Travel, 3X on Lyft, 2X on flights through Bilt Travel, and 1X on everything else.
earning.noteZh: 经 Bilt Travel（网站或 App）预订；合计倍数含 Bilt Rewards 的预订奖励。
earning.noteEn: Booked through Bilt Travel on the website or app; the total includes the Bilt Rewards booking bonus.

earning.quote: 3X on hotels through Bilt Travel, 3X on Lyft, 2X on flights through Bilt Travel, and 1X on everything else.
earning.noteZh: 经 Bilt Travel（网站或 App）预订；合计倍数含 Bilt Rewards 的预订奖励。
earning.noteEn: Booked through Bilt Travel on the website or app; the total includes the Bilt Rewards booking bonus.

earning.quote: Blue and Obsidian cardholders earn 3X total on Lyft, and Palladium cardholders earn 4X total.
earning.noteZh: 含 Bilt Rewards 的 Lyft 奖励，须在 Lyft 关联 Bilt 账户并设为当前积分伙伴。
earning.noteEn: Includes the Bilt Rewards Lyft bonus; link your Bilt account in Lyft and set Bilt as the active loyalty partner.

earning.quote: Other Eligible Purchases: You’ll earn 1 Bilt Point ("1X Points") on other Eligible Purchases.

credits.zh: 房租和房贷积分（经 Bilt 支付）
credits.en: Points on rent and mortgage paid through Bilt
credits.noteZh: 经 Bilt 支付房租、房贷不收交易费。默认“仅住房”方式按当期日常消费占住房付款的比例给0.5倍到1.25倍积分，不足25%时每期给250点；没有年度或每月上限。旧卡的每月5笔交易要求不适用于 Bilt Card 2.0。另有“Flexible Bilt Cash”方式，2027年1月1日起新开账户不能选。
credits.noteEn: No transaction fee on rent or mortgage paid through Bilt. Under the default housing-only option, the everyday spend in a billing cycle, as a share of the housing payment, sets 0.5X to 1.25X; below 25% the cycle earns 250 points. No annual or monthly cap. The original card's 5-transaction monthly minimum does not apply to Bilt Card 2.0. The Flexible Bilt Cash option is closed to accounts opened on or after January 1, 2027.
credits.quote: Earn up to 1.25X points on rent and mortgage payments

original.title: Points on rent and mortgage payments
original.summary: Earn up to 1.25X points on rent and mortgage payments with no transaction fee. With housing-only rewards, everyday spend in each billing cycle sets the multiplier; below 25% of the housing payment you earn 250 points.
howToUse: Pay rent or mortgage through the Bilt app or website with the card.
Your everyday spend in the billing cycle decides the housing multiplier.
quotes: If you do not meet the minimum 25% of your housing payment, you’ll earn 250 points.
The 5-transaction monthly minimum was a requirement of the original Bilt Card and does not apply to any Bilt Card 2.0
All three cards have no transaction fee on rent, mortgage and HOA

unknown.zh: Bilt 合作餐厅的“最高”倍数随餐厅变化，没有记录为固定比例。
unknown.en: The "up to" rate at Bilt partner restaurants varies by restaurant and is not recorded as a fixed rate.

unknown.zh: 保障类福利（手机保护、购物保障等）的额度和条件未从保障指南核实，未记录。
unknown.en: Protection benefits (cell phone, purchase assurance and others) are not recorded; their limits were not checked in the guide to benefits.

unknown.zh: 开卡奖励按个人报价变化，未记录。
unknown.en: Welcome offers vary by person and are not recorded.

transfer.name: Bilt Rewards
transfer.quote: Points transfer at a 1:1 ratio for Bilt travel partners.

fee.quote: Annual Fee $95; each authorized user: $50 per year.

earning.quote: earns 4X on hotels through Bilt Travel, 3X dining or grocery (up to 6X at Bilt dining partners; grocery up to $25k/year),
earning.noteZh: 经 Bilt Travel（网站或 App）预订；合计倍数含 Bilt Rewards 的预订奖励。
earning.noteEn: Booked through Bilt Travel on the website or app; the total includes the Bilt Rewards booking bonus.

earning.quote: 3X on flights through Bilt Travel, 2X on other travel, and includes a $100 annual Bilt Travel Hotel credit.
earning.noteZh: 经 Bilt Travel（网站或 App）预订；合计倍数含 Bilt Rewards 的预订奖励。
earning.noteEn: Booked through Bilt Travel on the website or app; the total includes the Bilt Rewards booking bonus.

earning.quote: if you select Dining as the bonus category (default)
earning.noteZh: 餐饮和超市二选一，默认餐饮；开户30天内可改一次，之后当年锁定。未选的类别按1倍。
earning.noteEn: Choose dining or grocery; dining is the default. You may change it once within 30 days of opening, then it is locked for the calendar year. The other category earns 1X.

earning.quote: up to $25,000 in combined grocery purchases by you and any Authorized Users on the Card Account
earning.noteZh: 选了超市时，每个自然年合计25,000美元内3倍，之后1倍；与餐饮二选一。
earning.noteEn: When grocery is chosen: 3X on up to $25,000 a calendar year, then 1X. Either grocery or dining.

earning.quote: You’ll earn 2 Bilt Points (1 base Bilt Point plus 1 bonus Bilt Point) per $1 spent on Eligible Purchases made directly
earning.noteZh: 直接向航空公司、酒店、邮轮和租车商户消费（按 Mastercard 商户类别）。
earning.noteEn: Bought directly from airlines, hotels, cruise lines and car rental agencies, by Mastercard merchant code.

earning.quote: Blue and Obsidian cardholders earn 3X total on Lyft, and Palladium cardholders earn 4X total.
earning.noteZh: 含 Bilt Rewards 的 Lyft 奖励，须在 Lyft 关联 Bilt 账户并设为当前积分伙伴。
earning.noteEn: Includes the Bilt Rewards Lyft bonus; link your Bilt account in Lyft and set Bilt as the active loyalty partner.

earning.quote: Other purchases: You’ll earn 1 reward point per $1 spent on other Eligible Purchases.

credits.zh: Bilt Travel 酒店额度（每半年50美元）
credits.noteZh: 1–6月、7–12月各最多50美元，用于本卡经 Bilt Travel 预订的2晚及以上酒店，结账时须选择使用额度。适用于2027年1月1日前开户的账户；这些账户在2027年1月1日或之后的第一个开卡周年日改为每年发放 Bilt Cash，除非持卡人作了 Legacy Election。
credits.noteEn: Up to $50 from January 1 through June 30 and up to $50 from July 1 through December 31, on hotel bookings of 2 nights or more made with the card through Bilt Travel; opt in at checkout. For accounts opened before January 1, 2027; at the first card anniversary on or after that date it is replaced by yearly Bilt Cash unless a Legacy Election was made.
credits.quote: Credits of up to $50 may be applied to qualifying hotel bookings made through the Bilt Travel Portal from January

original.title: $100 Bilt Travel Hotel Credit
original.summary: Up to $50 from January 1 through June 30 and up to $50 from July 1 through December 31 on qualifying hotel bookings of 2 nights or more through the Bilt Travel Portal, for a total of $100 each calendar year.
howToUse: Book a stay of 2 nights or more through the Bilt Travel Portal or the Bilt app with the card.
Turn on the credit at checkout.
quotes: for a total maximum of $100 each calendar year.

credits.zh: 每年100美元 Bilt Cash（2027年起）
credits.noteZh: 2027年1月1日或之后开户的账户，开户时和每个开卡周年日向主卡持卡人发放100美元 Bilt Cash；更早开户的账户从2027年1月1日或之后的第一个开卡周年日起适用，除非作了 Legacy Election。Bilt Cash 不是账单抵扣，发放后12个月到期。
credits.noteEn: $100 in Bilt Cash to the primary cardholder at account opening and on each card anniversary, for accounts opened on or after January 1, 2027; older accounts move to it at their first card anniversary on or after that date unless they made a Legacy Election. Bilt Cash is not a statement credit and expires 12 months after it is earned.
credits.quote: You, as the Primary Cardholder, will receive $100 in Bilt Cash.

original.title: $100 Bilt Cash Benefit
original.summary: $100 in Bilt Cash is credited to the primary cardholder's Bilt Rewards Account at account opening and on each card anniversary while the account stays open and in good standing.
howToUse: Bilt Cash is credited automatically; use it in the Bilt app or website before it expires.
